name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit facing the low cable with feet on the footrests and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with arms extended and trunk tall.
Pull the handle toward the lower ribs as the shoulder blades glide back.
Reach forward through the shoulders without rounding the lower back.
cues: Pull elbows close past the ribs.
mistakes: Rocking backward to move the stack.
breathing: Exhale as you pull; inhale as the arms extend.
